text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While strolling around after school for a change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Lighting and sound are all clear.
All that's left is checking the seating...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! My class has a live performance
practicum tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was making the rounds on patrol
to ensure everyone has a pleasant learning environment!
choice_data_list: I see. That's an admirable mindset.
I see, that's an admirable attitude.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Thank you!
Though I feel like things like this
are also part of a class rep's duty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So, it really isn't anything special――

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Did you just feel a drop?
Is it starting to rain...?
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a break for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right, let's take shelter in the school building.
We must hurry...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Phew...! 
Good thing neither of us got soaked.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's just a passing shower...
I'm so glad it should clear up soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... Maybe I should change the water
in the classroom vase while I still have time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And then we need to restock the chalk...
Oh, and run the eraser through the cleaner, too!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need a break?
Are you sure you don't need a break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Think of it as a break.
Simple, repetitive tasks can be quite refreshing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take my leave here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the stage the next day,
it appeared that particular practical training was underway...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! We'll wrap things up before the rain starts pouring!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and get inside so you don't get wet either,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Narita Top Road darted between the spectator rows with astonishing speed, checking each seat with her own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa! There's an empty can under the chair!
Someone must have left it behind and forgotten about it...!
choice_data_list: (Guess there was no need for me to help out after all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her competence, she finished the check
in no time at all and ran off toward the school building.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the stage the next day,
it appeared that particular practical training was underway...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was the stage tape always this easy to see?
Wait, didn't someone clean the floor too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
See! The faulty mics have already been set aside, too!
...Could this be the work of the class rep...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Practical training is about to start!
Wrap up your chatter and line up, please~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!" replied the students, lining up obediently.
And so, supporting everyone from behind the scenes, Narita Top Road proved her reliable nature once again...!
